notes.title: News about upcoming Demo & Sneak Peak
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045430/ff8f7fdbb1c13dcd413dc6a1b64c8291865e134f.png
Hey Everyone!
We wanted to share with you that we are still working hard on our upcoming co-op horror game. Our plan is to start testing with small groups of players at the end of this month.

Footage from the upcoming Demo
Here are some sneak peeks from one of the first sections of the demo - your human friend's apartment. You'll be searching for clues about her sudden disappearance. 🕵️‍♂️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045430/9b7e21c51b66e46fedb6638ba79891bbbd5d3c0b.jpg

Thank you for being on this journey with us!
Mantas & Martynas

notes.title: Early Gameplay Trailer out now & closed beta dates
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045430/ff8f7fdbb1c13dcd413dc6a1b64c8291865e134f.png
Hey Everyone!
We've been very busy for the last couple of months adding some really exciting stuff to the game as well as crafting an early gameplay trailer.

We have partnered with IGN to publish the trailer on their channel:
[previewyoutube=yEUsGGIJpv0;full][/previewyoutube]

We are also announcing the date for start of the closed beta which is
February 28th, 2025.
More details will arrive soon.

Thank you for being on this journey with us!
Mantas & Martynas

notes.title: How we plan to develop Haunted Paws!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045430/9c44341bcc11e1881b020e81bd3e6867ee092499.pngGreetings, Puppy Pals!
This is officially the first news update on the Haunted Paws Steam page! First of all, make sure to Wishlist and Follow the game! We plan to post updates about the development and it will be visible in your library if you follow the game!

Watch our Announcement Trailer!
If you still haven't see it yet, check out the Announcement trailer we posted on Youtube here:
[previewyoutube=EzOkMteLPnA;full][/previewyoutube]

Become a Game Insider!
Also you can join our Patreon (we have free tier) to follow our development journey and give us suggestions. Right know you can vote on which dog breeds should be included in our game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045430/074a7b036cfd5f371d1c22caf3239615f3c4f09d.gif

Upcoming Demo
Currently, we're developing the first Demo of the game, which we plan to release in a few months. Our task is to create a demo that allows you to design your own puppy and customize it with various accessories. Make sure you follow our game on Steam so you don't miss when it comes out!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045430/b3cb74d64b04107f208573cf9fccda31d832d72f.gif

Cheers,
Mantas & Martynas
